description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mox Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Mox Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Choose to sacrifice Mox Diamond instead of having it enter the battlefield.
Repeat.
